title: Jesse Freese (Sequoia · founder of StartupExperts) on the Responsive fireside — 'Thoughtful, practical, and one of those sessions that could have easily gone another hour'
summary: Jesse Freese — business consultant at Sequoia, founder of StartupExperts and host of the Becoming Better Podcast — writes up two days at Responsive Conference 2026 and singles out Jamie Lynn White's conversation with Eric as one he particularly enjoyed. He co-hosted the closing happy hour and calls Responsive one of the most thoughtful conferences he attends each year.
blockquote: One conversation I particularly enjoyed was Jamie Lynn White's discussion with Eric Ries. Thoughtful, practical, and one of those sessions that could have easily gone another hour.
